_about: Department id to name mapping, and the per-department field rules. Loaded by IRSTasks/services/ConfigService as 'departments'. Static configuration only - nothing secret, it is downloadable by any widget user.

<department id>.name: the department's display name
hideFields: field ids hidden for this department (WP06 F2 - a flag on a field, not a separate form)

_status: empty: the department objects exist on the VM but their ids have not been collected, and no form has fields to hide yet. Fill from the project's Department relationship (WP03 WGT-05).
